description: Write a certificate, private key and CA chain into a folder on this host, in the 'named' layout (<basename>.crt/.key/.ca/.fullchain.crt) or the 'pem' layout (fullchain.pem + privkey.pem). Files are mode 640, the folder 750, optionally group-owned. Overwrites existing files in place. Set test to true to check that a deploy would work, changing nothing. The certificate, key and CA are not arguments: they are run input fields cert, key and ca (the script is declared input=fields in scripts.conf). The key field is a PRIVATE KEY.

test.description: Check that a deploy would work and change nothing. When true, the input fields are not used.

target_dir.description: Absolute path of the folder to write into. Created if missing. Must not contain '..'.

basename.description: File name stem, usually the domain (example.com). Used by the 'named' layout; ignored in file names by 'pem'.

group.description: Group (name or numeric gid) to own the folder and files, so a service in that group can read the key. '-' leaves the group unchanged. For a container, the gid of the service user inside the container.

cert.description: PEM text of the certificate (fullchain). Required unless test is true.

key.description: SECRET: PEM text of the PRIVATE KEY. Required unless test is true.

ca.description: PEM text of the CA chain. Required unless test is true.
